core_job: Help American Group LLC's own decision-makers (the founder and invited staff or partners) read any of the 200 bundled project-spec documents offline, search all of them in seconds, and record a stage decision with its reason. Then get that decision back into the repository. This is an internal tool, not a public product. The recommendation (D4) is to retire it from the public stores and distribute it through TestFlight internal testing and Play internal testing. Apple's own 2.1 message points to Guideline 3.2's other distribution options for apps meant for one organisation, and Apple's Unlisted App Distribution page (fetched 2026-10-12, HTTP 200) names "employee resources" as a good candidate. Build is gated: nothing starts until the founder answers D4. Issue #25 is OPEN with 0 comments as of 2026-10-12.
signature: Decision docket export. The app already records stage moves and notes. A new on-device builder turns them, together with a persisted shortlist, into ready-to-commit Markdown. Each entry carries the date, project, from→to, note, priority rank and score out of 100, and whether the gate is met. Shared-infrastructure records carry no rank, and none is invented. The output also includes a summary of the board as it stands now. It is previewed in the app, can be limited to all moves, the last 7 days, or everything since the last export, and is copied with one tap through Clipboard (pure Flutter, no plugin), ready to paste into a PR against PORTFOLIO.md. Generic tools like Notion and Trello cannot produce this because they do not know this corpus's stages, 10-axis scores or gate criteria. No network is used.
